'''ONEOK WesTex Transmission''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.oneok.com/OWT|title=oneok.com|website=oneok.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Texas Panhandle, Texas to Waha Hub, Texas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.oneok.com/OWT|title=oneok.com|website=oneok.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''ONEOK Inc<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.oneok.com/OWT|title=oneok.com|website=oneok.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''777 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.oneok.com/OWT|title=oneok.com|website=oneok.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''2,217 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.oneok.com/OWT|title=oneok.com|website=oneok.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''24 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.oneok.com/OWT|title=oneok.com|website=oneok.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.oneok.com/OWT|title=oneok.com|website=oneok.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
